opening_strategy: Introduce a new framework or tool for building AI assistants.
information_order: Describe the purpose and core functionality of the framework.
Explain the benefits and use cases.
Mention the open-source nature and call for feedback.
evidence_style: Descriptive, highlighting capabilities and ease of use.
question_or_cta: Encourage users to try the framework and share their creations.
common_weaknesses: Potential issues with text generation quality after fine-tuning.
Confusion regarding training metrics and their interpretation.
Unexpected or irrelevant output during generation.
Difficulty in retaining specific details from training data.
